kind: Actual mileage board SQL/window functions with independent in-memory SQLite fixtures; no app/network/business data

checks.name: Beijing default is Jan 1 while UTC and New York remain Dec 31
Monday week spans Dec 28 to Jan 4 and excludes Sunday before start
Day/month/year/all are independently aggregated; future starts and uncounted/other-club rows excluded
Leap February end is exclusive and valid leap-day run is included
Tied rankings are deterministic and retain zero-run current members
Group rankings recompute places, expose empty groups, and use canonical counted volume
Omitted group means all; zero means only ungrouped; empty real group remains explicit
Invalid calendar dates/ranges/group IDs and foreign groups are rejected
Activity association validates permanent IDs; custom group omits association and freezes current group values
